title: The Hematic Stake
subtitle: An anchor for a Fane
text: Each stake adds a lobe to a Fane's envelope and must overlap the heart or another stake. A progenitor calls one up with an empty hand, sneaking against a block in or beside their Fane. From the fifth Degree one can also be raised in place: set a Blood Crystal on Hematic Iron Bars, hold a Sanguine Formation in your offhand and pour 100 mL into the bars. A line holds three stakes, and one more for each member and each recruited kind, up to the server's limit. Only the line's owner may take one up.
